Compliance Answer: A Risk Management and Compliance Programme should include a risk-based approach to combating ML, TF, and PF with controls proportionate to the level of risks identified on business, client, and product levels. It must also have documented procedures for conducting these assessments as per FIC guidance not e 7 sets out guidance on RBA (Source: [Source 1: FIC-Act-reference-guide.txt, Chunk 6143]).

Relevant Regulatory Basis: Reference Guide and Guidance Not e 7 for a risk management approach as per the Financial Crime Commission Act reference guide on page 8 of section 25 (Source: [Source 1: FIC-Act-reference-guide.txt, Chunk 6143]).

Explanation: The Risk Management and Compliance Programme should incorporate a risk assessment mechanism that is proportionate to the identified ML/TF risks on various levels (business, client) as well as for new products or processes in line with FIC guidance not e 7.
